origine.title: The origin
origine.subtitle: As a child, a small car n°20
origine.description: I pour the color and I roll. The wheel becomes a brush.

atelier.title: The workshop
atelier.subtitle: Guillaume Farré — Among the cars
atelier.description: The workshop brings together vehicles, tools, and materials. Guillaume Farré among his two grey cars, instruments of creation. This is where movement becomes form.

creations.title: Two distinct creations
creations.subtitle: Canvases & Photographs
creations.description: The canvases are unique works created by movement. The photographs document these moments of creation, freeze the energy of the gesture, and become works themselves in limited editions.

photographies.title: The photographs
photographies.subtitle: Capturing the creative instant
photographies.description: Fine art pigment prints — Limited and open editions — Photography captures the instant when movement creates the image.

conceptCarArt.title: Concept Car Art
conceptCarArt.subtitle: When the automobile becomes a brush
conceptCarArt.description: A unique event where the red Ferrari joins the small car n°20. The workshop opens its doors for a live performance.

acquerir.title: Acquire a work
acquerir.subtitle: Numbered and signed editions
acquerir.description: Photographs: A4, A3, A2 formats — Black or aluminum framing — From 2000€. Canvases: by appointment at the workshop.

histoire.title: The story
histoire.subtitle: Guillaume Farré — From first drawings to today
histoire.description: From sketchbooks to monumental sculptures, trace Guillaume Farré's artistic journey. A life dedicated to capturing automotive movement.
